name: marketing-psychology
description: Evidence grades and consumer-protection rule checks for the psychology in your marketing. Grade a claim such as 'losses hurt twice as much' against the original studies and their replications. Audit a page, email or paywall for the levers it uses: each one is quoted, graded and paired with the fact that makes it legitimate. Check countdowns, stock badges, reviews, 'was' prices, trials and cancellation paths against dated US, EU and UK rules. Read price tiers for anchors and decoys with the arithmetic shown. Find why users stop before a key step, such as connecting data or upgrading, and what to fix first. Never invents proof, studies or a promised lift.

interface.longDescription: Five skills that check the psychology in your marketing. Dark-pattern check says whether a countdown, stock badge, review, "was" price, fee, pre-ticked extra, trial, cancel path or consent banner may break US, EU or UK consumer rules, with the date each rule was read, and gives an honest version. Persuasion audit marks each lever on a page, email or paywall keep, fix or remove and says how to collect real proof. Price framing does the savings, per-seat and per-day math, checks for decoy tiers and compares percent and amount discounts. Evidence check says whether claims like "losses hurt twice as much" hold up and how to phrase them. Behavior diagnosis finds why users stop before a key step and ranks fixes that remove friction first. It never writes fake proof, never predicts a lift and is not legal advice; rules read more than six months ago are flagged for re-checking.
defaultPrompt: Our banner says 'Was $120, now $79, ends tonight' and resets daily. Is that a dark pattern in the EU and US?
Audit our signup page: hero 'Save 10 hours a week', 3 client logos, 'Only 2 spots left!' timer. Keep, fix or remove?
Tiers $29/$79/$199 a month, 3/10/unlimited seats, Pro annual $790. Check anchors, decoy and discount framing with the math.
